description: Export the current FaceSign session configuration as a standalone, deployable Next.js application. You MUST supply `landingHtml` (pre-session page), `recapHtml` (results page), and `uiStrings` (per-language dictionary whose keys are invented by you to match placeholders in the HTML). The exported app ships NO default chrome — every visible string comes from you. Run with `npm install && npm run dev` or deploy to Vercel after setting FACESIGN_API_KEY.

appName.description: Name for the generated app (used in package.json, defaults to 'facesign-app')

avatarId.description: Avatar ID from the facesign://catalog resource.

clientReferenceId.description: Your own reference ID for this session

autoHide.description: Whether controls may automatically fade out. Omitted or true preserves the default behavior; false keeps the selected buttons visible. Ignored when showUxControls is false

buttons.description: Optional exact subset of in-session control buttons. Omit this field for the recommended default panel with all applicable controls. Set it only when the user requests a specialized flow or UI; for example, ["captions"] creates a captions-only panel, while an empty array hides the panel. Ignored when showUxControls is false

captionsOpenedByDefault.description: Start the session with the closed-captions (transcript) panel open. Omitted or false keeps it closed. The user can toggle it with the CC button either way. Set it for accessibility, or when viewers may be reading along in a second language. Ignored when showUxControls is false

showUxControls.description: Master switch for the in-session control panel. When false the panel is not rendered and every other controls.* setting has no effect

buttonTextTranslates.description: Localized permission-button text, for example { es: 'Continuar' }

defaultLang.description: Optional fallback BCP-47 language code used when the end-user's browser language is not in `langs`. DEFAULT BEHAVIOUR: OMIT this parameter. When set, must be one of the codes in `langs` (if `langs` is also set).

extractionSchema.description: Optional schema describing fields the FaceSign backend should extract from the session transcript using an LLM. Results are populated post-session at `session.report.extractedData` as `{ [fieldName]: string | number | boolean | null }` (null when the transcript did not contain the data). Render results in your recapHtml when present.

description.description: Natural-language hint for the LLM describing what to look for in the transcript. This is the primary extraction signal — be specific.

enum.description: Optional allowed string values. When set, the LLM normalizes free-form answers into one of the listed values.

fieldName.description: Key under which the extracted value appears in session.report.extractedData.

type.description: Expected value type. `date` is returned as an ISO 8601 string.

flow.description: Array of nodes forming the session's directed graph

outcome.description: The id of the next node

awaitExternal.description: Optional background poll: the avatar keeps talking (normal outcomes stay active) while an external result becomes ready; exits via onDataReady/onTimeout/onError

exits.description: Where to route when the background poll resolves

onDataReady.description: Node id when the endpoint returns HTTP 200 (result ready)

onError.description: Node id when the call errors

onTimeout.description: Node id when poll.timeoutMs elapses first

timeoutMs.description: Total time to keep polling before giving up

request.description: The endpoint to poll in the background

method.description: HTTP method. Defaults to POST (JSON body); GET sends vars as query params

url.description: Endpoint to call (must pass the server-side allowlist). The current sessionId is appended automatically as a query parameter

vars.description: Payload variables, each resolving to a literal or a session value

name.description: Key under which the value is placed in the request payload

field.description: The field/key name within the source

source.description: Source to resolve the referenced value from

value.description: Literal value or a reference resolved from session data

doesNotRequireReply.description: If true, avatar speaks without waiting for user reply

outcomes.description: Array of {id, targetNodeId, condition} routing entries

targetNodeId.description: The id of the node to route to

prompt.description: What the avatar says to the user

outcomes.description: Record mapping each outcome to a target node id. All four are required

deepfakeDetected.description: Node id when deepfake is detected

inconclusive.description: Node id when the check produced no verdict — the detector could not decide, did not run, or there was nothing to analyse. This is our failure, not the user's: route it to a retry, a step-up or a manual review, never to the happy path by default

livenessDetected.description: Node id when liveness is confirmed

noFace.description: Node id when frames were captured but no face is on them

outcomes.description: Record mapping each outcome to a target node id

emailEntered.description: Node id when email is provided

prompt.description: Optional phrase the avatar says at the moment the email input field appears (direct speech, e.g. "Could you please enter your email address?"). Keep it short — one sentence. Omit to let the avatar stay silent while the field is shown.

newUser.description: Node id when user is new

noFace.description: Node id when no face is found

recognized.description: Node id when user is recognized

notPassed.description: Node id when face scan fails

passed.description: Node id when face scan passes

failed_unverified.description: Node id when max attempts exhausted

permissionsDenied.description: Node id when permissions are denied

permissionsGranted.description: Node id when permissions are granted

prompt.description: Optional message the avatar says (direct speech mode, e.g. 'Say: Please enable your camera.')

outcomes.description: Record mapping each outcome to a target node id

imageUnavailable.description: Node id when one or both images could not be obtained

noMatch.description: Node id when faces do not match

similarityThreshold.description: 0-1, minimum similarity score required for a match

providedDataKey.description: Required when source is 'providedData' — the key in providedData that holds the image URL

outcome.description: Node id to advance to after the response is merged into providedData (never branches)

request.description: The external endpoint to call and the payload to send

default.description: Node id to route to when no rule matches

rules.description: Rules evaluated top-to-bottom; first match wins

left.description: Reference to the session value to test

field.description: The field/key name within the source

source.description: Where the value is read from: 'extractedData' (a field from extractionSchema, extracted on demand from the transcript) or 'providedData' (a key set at creation or written by a prior external_call)

outcome.description: Node id to route to when this rule matches

right.description: Literal or reference to compare against; omit for 'exists'/'notExists'

flowVariants.description: Optional additional flows declared at export time. The landing page selects one by calling window.__startSession({ flowId: 'variant-id' }); the browser never sends a graph.

langs.description: Optional whitelist of BCP-47 language codes (from facesign://catalog) the exported session may use. DEFAULT BEHAVIOUR (recommended): OMIT this parameter entirely — the app then supports every language in the FaceSign catalog, and `uiStrings` must cover every catalog language. ONLY set `langs` when the user EXPLICITLY restricts the language set (e.g. 'Spanish-only demo', 'support English and Russian'). Do NOT narrow to `['en']` just because the user described the demo in English or did not mention languages. Example (explicit restriction): ["en", "es", "ru"]. The set of target languages for `uiStrings` is derived from this list (or the full catalog if omitted).

postSessionLiveness.description: Enable post-session liveness assessment with the selected public policy version. The result is available in session.report.postSessionLiveness after the interaction.

uiStrings.description: REQUIRED. Per-language UI string dictionary: { langId: { key: translatedString } }. You invent the keys to match {{KEY}} / window.t('KEY') in landingHtml and recapHtml. Must contain `en` plus every language in `langs` (or every catalog language if `langs` is omitted). All per-language dicts must share the IDENTICAL key set.
